purpose: Teach: 洗面/殺菌/バレンタインデー/ベーグル/教習所/ナポリ/競輪/大文字

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、洗面台広いんだろ?
lines.en: Your bathroom sink is huge, isn't it, Riku?
lines.style: Casual, teasing lilt on the question. Leaning in slightly, enjoying the randomness of her own observation. Quick and unguarded.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食前にちゃんと殺菌してから手洗えよ、桜
lines.en: You should actually disinfect your hands before lunch, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact delivery without edge. A small wince at his own pedantry. Deflecting her teasing with practicality, but there's affection underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、バレンタインデーに友チョコ配ってんだろ?
lines.en: So you hand out friend chocolates on Valentine's Day, right?
lines.style: Conspiratorial, delighted by catching him in something. Eyebrows up. Testing to see if he'll admit it or dodge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ベーグル屋でバイトしてんだろ?桜
lines.en: Wait — you work at a bagel place, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turned around on her. Quiet triumph. Calling her out with the same rhythm she uses on him. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお兄ちゃん、教習所通ってんだろ?
lines.en: Your older brother's in driving school right now, isn't he?
lines.style: Pressing forward, rapid-fire. Enjoying the back-and-forth. Each fact offered like a small card she's laying down.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行でナポリ行きたいって言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You told me you wanted to go to Naples on the school trip.
lines.style: Softer now. Shifting from teasing to remembering. Quiet acknowledgment that he listens and holds onto things she says. Not accusatory—affectionate.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お父さんが競輪行くって心配してたな
lines.en: You were worried about your dad going to the keirin races.
lines.style: Gentler still. No longer teasing. A small, careful statement of what he's been carrying. Direct but not confrontational. The tone of someone who sees something and doesn't look away.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏の大文字焼き見に行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You saw the Daimonji fire with me last summer, remember?
lines.style: Close and quiet. Almost to herself, but meant for him. The memory is tender, specific. Saying: I was there too. I remember. Trailing off slightly, letting him sit with it.
